transcript:
Meeting header:
Date/Time: 2027-08-12 10:00 PDT
Duration: 55 minutes
Attendees: Alex Martinez (Redwood AE), Priya Shah (Redwood SE), Daniel Li (Redwood Product), Sofia Reyes (AuroraCloud PM), Markus Braun (AuroraCloud Marketplace Eng), Leah Kim (AuroraCloud Security), Kenji Ito (AuroraCloud Infra)

[00:00] Alex Martinez (Redwood AE): Hey everyone, thanks for joining. quick agenda — marketplace listing checklist, reference arch, security items, and next steps. we have about 55 minutes.

[00:25] Sofia Reyes (AuroraCloud PM): Thanks Alex. excited to get this moving. high level we want a marketplace listing plus a joint reference architecture so our customers can deploy Redwood inference through AuroraCloud marketplace. timeline is tight — marketing wants a preview by end of month.

[00:45] Priya Shah (Redwood SE): awesome. i'll cover the reference arch details — VPC peering / private control plane options, kms/hsm notes, recommended instance profiles, and an example terraform snippet. quick note: our private deployment option requires a customer-managed VPC or on-prem proxy; for marketplace we typically recommend the private control plane with a secure onboarding flow.

[01:10] Markus Braun (AuroraCloud Marketplace Eng): quick Q on billing — do you expect us to handle metering and charge-through in Aurora marketplace or do you want us to call Redwood billing APIs for usage?

[01:22] Daniel Li (Redwood Product): for the initial listing we prefer marketplace-metered billing where Aurora collects and forwards settlement per marketplace terms. Redwood can integrate via a webhook to reconcile usage; alternatively for dedicated customers we do direct invoicing. either works, but need to document the data model for usage events.

[01:45] Leah Kim (AuroraCloud Security): security checklist — we need SOC 2, SAML SSO metadata, RBAC mapping, encryption details (KMS/HSM), and audit log formats. also any PII retention policies. can you share how Redwood handles KV cache and logs? i sometimes see kd cache or k v cache in docs and want to make sure logging is minimal.

[02:10] Priya Shah (Redwood SE): yes, on KV cache — we call it KV cache (sometimes transcribed weird), it's in-memory on the serving nodes, not persisted unless customer enables caching snapshot; audit logs include request IDs and token counts but no raw user payload by default for hosted flows. for private deployments customers can opt-in to retain full logs; we document that in the reference arch.

[02:40] Kenji Ito (AuroraCloud Infra): for marketplace deployment we need a simple terraform provider snippet to create service account and grant limited roles. can Redwood provide a sample?

[02:50] Priya Shah (Redwood SE): yes, i'll produce a terraform example that shows provisioning, IAM roles, and sample network peering config. will include notes about firewall ports for the control plane and recommended subnets.

[03:05] Sofia Reyes (AuroraCloud PM): marketing assets — logos, screenshots, short description, and 2-3 usage examples. also need a one-page joint solution blurb.

[03:18] Alex Martinez (Redwood AE): Redwood will share a draft listing package: logos in svg/png, 2 screenshots (console + sample deploy), a 250-word blurb, and a pricing grid. we'll also include suggested tiers: self-serve hosted, dedicated reserved capacity, and private (VPC/on-prem).

[03:40] Markus Braun (AuroraCloud Marketplace Eng): integrations — do you have a sandbox/test mode for us to exercise the APIs without billing implications?

[03:50] Daniel Li (Redwood Product): yes, we have a sandbox tenant we can spin up for partners; will provide test API keys and a sample dataset for E2E validation. SE will run a smoke test during the demo.

[04:05] Leah Kim (AuroraCloud Security): SOC 2 — do you have an external report we can link or a bridge letter? we need to vet controls.

[04:12] Alex Martinez (Redwood AE): we can share an access link to our SOC 2 report via an NDA portal and provide a summary of controls. for SAML we'll send metadata and SSO onboarding docs.

[04:30] Sofia Reyes (AuroraCloud PM): on certifications — some customers require data residency notes. can we call out Redwood hosted regions and private deployment on-prem options in the listing?

[04:45] Priya Shah (Redwood SE): yes. we'll include a table of regions, supported instance types, and notes about private VPC/on-prem packaging. note: quantization profiles and latency expectations should be included to set customer expectations.

[05:05] Markus Braun (AuroraCloud Marketplace Eng): any blockers from Redwood side for a listing launch?

[05:10] Alex Martinez (Redwood AE): main dependencies are assets (logos/screenshots), security artifacts, and the reference arch + terraform snippet. also need acceptance criteria for the marketplace QA — e.g., deploy a sample app, validate billing events, and confirm SSO flow.

[05:30] Priya Shah (Redwood SE): i'll propose an acceptance test plan: 1) deploy reference arch via terraform into test tenant, 2) run sample inference job and measure latency/success, 3) validate billing webhook receives usage events, 4) run SSO login and check RBAC mapping.

[05:55] Kenji Ito (AuroraCloud Infra): on the terraform, we prefer minimal privileges service account and an example of client certificate rotation if possible.

[06:05] Priya Shah (Redwood SE): will add key rotation notes and recommend using KMS-backed secrets for service credentials.

[06:22] Sofia Reyes (AuroraCloud PM): timeline recap — if we get assets and SOC2 by Aug 19, we can run the E2E demo week of Aug 23 and aim for a soft listing the following week. marketing wants a preview for partner newsletter.

[06:40] Alex Martinez (Redwood AE): sounds good. i'll send the checklist today and include suggested copy.

[06:55] Leah Kim (AuroraCloud Security): one more on logs — can Redwood support structured audit logs with request ID, model version, token counts, and no raw prompt in the marketplace flow?

[07:10] Priya Shah (Redwood SE): yes default marketplace hosted flows redact payloads in logs; for private deployments customers can enable full logging under their control. we'll document the schema for audit logs.

[07:30] Markus Braun (AuroraCloud Marketplace Eng): competitor note — some partners highlight pre-built connectors to Databricks; do you have examples of customers using Redwood in similar setups?

[07:42] Daniel Li (Redwood Product): we do, we'll share a one-pager of reference customers and a short case study. nothing that conflicts with NDA but enough for marketplace listing.

[08:05] Alex Martinez (Redwood AE): wrap-up — owners and due dates captured. next meeting: follow-up E2E demo week of Aug 23, tentative invite to be sent. I will share checklist and draft listing assets by Aug 16.

[08:22] Sofia Reyes (AuroraCloud PM): thanks all, this was super helpful.

[08:30] End of recording.

Recap / explicit next steps at end of transcript: Redwood: send listing assets + checklist (Alex) by 2027-08-16; SE to share reference arch + terraform snippet (Priya) by 2027-08-20; AuroraCloud: provision test tenant (Markus) by 2027-08-18; Security (Leah) to share SOC2 and SAML metadata by 2027-08-19; schedule E2E demo week of 2027-08-23.
